grammar.title: Formal ability with 能够
grammar.explanation: 能够 (nénggòu) means "to be able to", just like 能, but sounds a little more formal and is common in writing or careful speech. In everyday talk, 能 alone is usually enough.

grammar.title: Completing tasks with 完成
grammar.explanation: 完成 (wánchéng) means "to complete, to accomplish" it is used for finishing a task, plan, or piece of work, not just an everyday action like eating or reading (for those, use 完).

sentences.zh: 我们能够完成这个工作。
sentences.en: We are able to complete this work.
He is able to help us.

sentences.zh: 学生能够回答这个问题。
sentences.en: Students are able to answer this question.
Are you able to trust him?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wánchéng le jīntiān de gōngzuò.
Tāmen wánchéng le zhè jiàn shì.
